Sentence (English): Purchased online from HD mid-September '23.
Comments (English): Purchased online from HD mid-September '23. Coming from a previous KA dishwasher, we expect the best right out of the gate. SO, the pros:. Love the towel bar, the print-free SS is def an improvement, the extra third rack is surprisingly helpful (love it now), it holds a lot of dishes especially with the options of moving the middle rack up or down, the dishes are squeaky clean (almost silky) and dry (we use ProWash, Hi Temp Wash, Sani Rinse, Heated dry and Extended Heat Dry). the Cons:. IF you are coming from another KA, this model may not seem as quiet as the reviewers claim. While this model is VERY quiet, the model that we just replaced could not be heard. Next, the machine cavity sits lower than our previous model. I am 5'2\" and it seems low to me, so it may seem very low to an individual who is taller. Please note that many reviews stated that their washer left dishes soaked; after two test cycles, ours were clean but also wet. Once we filled the rinse aid, however, all dishes are dry. There were also reviews stating that glasses were tipping over in the middle rack but we have not had any issues with that, nor with dinner plates not fitting on the bottom rack. Buy with confidence!

Sentence (English): I was offered this dishwasher from Bosch as a replacement for my previous dishwasher which caught on fire.
Comments (English): [ Disappointing Racks ] || ---------------- || I was offered this dishwasher from Bosch as a replacement for my previous dishwasher which caught on fire. I wish I had taken the time to go to a showroom to look at it. The rear plate dividers on the lower rack are too close to each other to hold our everyday Dansk dishes with have a 3/4" profile. The fit fine in the front area of the rack but this mean I have to move the cutlery holder to the back. Also, when loaded, the weight is all in the front of the rack so when you pull the rack out, the front wheels can easily drop into the gap between the dishwasher and the open drawer. The upper rack also siginificantly changed with too many angled areas that a large glass will not sit on without falling over. When buying a new dishwasher, I receommend taking a few dishes and glasses/mugs to a store to make sure they will fit.

To make matters worse, after calling customer service they scheduled a repair with a company who did not show up and couldn't be reached via the contact number. NO ONE TOLD ME! They then scheduled another appointment with another repair service for the next day. I then received a text from that repair company letting me know they actually were not available during the day and time KitchenAid had scheduled but would reschedule for the next week. They showed up today on time but had been given the wrong repair information by KitchenAid so they did not have the proper parts to fix my dishwasher. The repair technician then looked up the part, found that it is currently out of stock, and will have to call me back when the part finally becomes available in the future to do the repair. This is all for a dishwasher that is now 3 weeks old! I feel good business practice would be for KitchenAid to offer me a $100 (or more) rebate or a free extended 2-3 year warranty in light of all of this.

Sentence (English): I feel the purchase of this dishwasher was a mistake for me.
Comments (English): [ Dished on dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I feel the purchase of this dishwasher was a mistake for me. I don't like the controls and options it has for cleaning. It stinks like salmon when the door has been left closed. It makes the dishes smell funny after they have been washed. The dishes air out after being taken out for a couple of hours. I don't like the racks. The bottom rack the line of tines are way to far apart so you don't have as much loading room for everything but really big items. I read the loading instructions but sorry to say I don't have sets of dishes like they are showing. The top rack has clips in the middle that make dishes like bowls not usable there. The tines go one way then the clip then they turn and go the opposite way. I do have to say the sides are spaced great for the large mugs I have but again you run into the clips in the middle. I have discovered I don't like the stainless steel inside at all. The buttons on the door are very sensitive, so when I lean forward to turn on coffee maker I also turn on the dishwasher (moving the coffee machine and everything in the cabinet above it won't work in my kitchen). Ok I do like how it looks and again the finger print resistant stainless is great.

Sentence (English): I know there are *a lot* of positive reviews for this machine.
Comments (English): [ Profoundly disappointed ] || ---------------- || I know there are *a lot* of positive reviews for this machine. And I know that Wirecutter loves it, but this machine is a complete disappointment for me, and every time I use this machine I wish I didn't have it. I would prefer to have my 26 year-old Kenmore back, if I could. Two major issues:. - DEAD FISH SMELL - I will note that this problem is not unique to this dishwasher -- it appears to be endemic to countless modern dishwashers, but this unit definitely has it. The issue is that the dishes end up smelling like dead fish. It is often so strong that I cannot eat from those dishes without *thoroughly* hand washing them again first. There are countless reports online, and discussion threads that are years long filled with people trying to solve this issue. There is no magic bullet. People have reported success with a variety of techniques, some only partial success, some have never been able to solve the issue, and some will purchase a different dishwasher with their fingers crossed. And if you're wondering, our filters are clean inside. The problem was present with the very first cycle. - Absolutely TERRIBLE RACK DESIGN. Just awful. Like how can wirecutter praise these machines? It is designed to be used in a very specific way. The bottom really only works well if you have a lots of plates and thin bowls. That is just not our use pattern. We use lots of cups, deep bowls, pots, mugs, bakeware, and cheap storage ware. Because the design is so single-minded, we can only load approximately half the dishes compared to our old machine. Also note that one of the mounting clips for the moveable tines began to break within the first 3 weeks because it is apparently *very* easy to move the moveable tine in the wrong direction? Other notes:. - I am coming from 26 year old kenmore with the rotating timer, a heating element, and the big lever handle that you flip from left to right to lock and turn on the machine. That machine began to die all at once. IT could have been saved, but it would have cost as much as this new dishwasher. - Sometimes new is nice. And while I didn't pick it out -- my landlord did -- I may have very well ended up selecting this unit based on the reviews. I was really looking forward to this machine. But that anticipation has quickly grown into a profound disappointment. It's something that I have come to lament nearly every day when I interact with this machine. - Air drying seems to work ok, Considering how hot the dishes get, it makes me wonder how much energy you really save with these units. I think I would still prefer a heater element in the base. - I haven't figured out a way to pause the machine and open the door without water spraying out when you open it. That might just be me. - It does in fact seem to clean dishes well enough. But it is not a magic box, and you will most likely need to remove / rinse egg yolk from your plate before you wash it -- as just on example. - The fact that it actually seems to clean the dishes to some effect, and that the drying seems to work decently, and that it really is very quiet, just makes the disappointment about the fish smell and poor rack design hit that much harder.

Also note that one of the mounting clips for the moveable tines began to break within the first 3 weeks because it is apparently *very* easy to move the moveable tine in the wrong direction? And while I didn't pick it out -- my landlord did -- I may have very well ended up selecting this unit based on the reviews. I was really looking forward to this machine. But that anticipation has quickly grown into a profound disappointment. I would prefer to have my 26 year-old Kenmore back, if I could. Two major issues:- DEAD FISH SMELL - I will note that this problem is not unique to this dishwasher -- it appears to be endemic to countless modern dishwashers, but this unit definitely has it.  The issue is that the dishes end up smelling like dead fish.  It is often so strong that I cannot eat from those dishes without *thoroughly* hand washing them again first.  There are countless reports online, and discussion threads that are years long filled with people trying to solve this issue.  There is no magic bullet.  People have reported success with a variety of techniques, some only partial success, some have never been able to solve the issue, and some will purchase a different dishwasher with their fingers crossed.  And if you're wondering, our filters are clean inside.  The problem was present with the very first cycle.  - Absolutely TERRIBLE RACK DESIGN.  Just awful.  Like how can wirecutter praise these machines?  It is designed to be used in a very specific way.  The bottom really only works well if you have a lots of plates and thin bowls.  That is just not our use pattern.  We use lots of cups, deep bowls, pots, mugs, bakeware, and cheap storage ware.  Because the design is so single-minded, we can only load approximately half the dishes compared to our old machine.  Also note that one of the mounting clips for the moveable tines began to break within the first 3 weeks because it is apparently *very* easy to move the moveable tine in the wrong direction? Other notes:- I am coming from 26 year old kenmore with the rotating timer, a heating element, and the big lever handle that you flip from left to right to lock and turn on the machine. That machine began to die all at once.  IT could have been saved, but it would have cost as much as this new dishwasher.  - Sometimes new is nice.  And while I didn't pick it out -- my landlord did -- I may have very well ended up selecting this unit based on the reviews.  I was really looking forward to this machine. But that anticipation has quickly grown into a profound disappointment.  It's something that I have come to lament nearly every day when I interact with this machine.  - Air drying seems to work ok, Considering how hot the dishes get, it makes me wonder how much energy you really save with these units. I think I would still prefer a heater element in the base.  - I haven't figured out a way to pause the machine and open the door without water spraying out when you open it. That might just be me. - It does in fact seem to clean dishes well enough.  But it is not a magic box, and you will most likely need to remove / rinse egg yolk from your plate before you wash it -- as just on example.- The fact that it actually seems to clean the dishes to some effect, and that the drying seems to work decently, and that it really is very quiet, just makes the disappointment about the fish smell and poor rack design hit that much harder.

And I know that Wirecutter loves it, but this machine is a complete disappointment for me, and every time I use this machine I wish I didn't have it. I would prefer to have my 26 year-old Kenmore back, if I could. Two major issues:. - DEAD FISH SMELL - I will note that this problem is not unique to this dishwasher -- it appears to be endemic to countless modern dishwashers, but this unit definitely has it. The issue is that the dishes end up smelling like dead fish. It is often so strong that I cannot eat from those dishes without *thoroughly* hand washing them again first. There are countless reports online, and discussion threads that are years long filled with people trying to solve this issue. There is no magic bullet. People have reported success with a variety of techniques, some only partial success, some have never been able to solve the issue, and some will purchase a different dishwasher with their fingers crossed. And if you're wondering, our filters are clean inside. The problem was present with the very first cycle. - Absolutely TERRIBLE RACK DESIGN. Just awful. Like how can wirecutter praise these machines? It is designed to be used in a very specific way. The bottom really only works well if you have a lots of plates and thin bowls. That is just not our use pattern. We use lots of cups, deep bowls, pots, mugs, bakeware, and cheap storage ware. Because the design is so single-minded, we can only load approximately half the dishes compared to our old machine. Also note that one of the mounting clips for the moveable tines began to break within the first 3 weeks because it is apparently *very* easy to move the moveable tine in the wrong direction? Other notes:. - I am coming from 26 year old kenmore with the rotating timer, a heating element, and the big lever handle that you flip from left to right to lock and turn on the machine. That machine began to die all at once. IT could have been saved, but it would have cost as much as this new dishwasher. - Sometimes new is nice. And while I didn't pick it out -- my landlord did -- I may have very well ended up selecting this unit based on the reviews. I was really looking forward to this machine. But that anticipation has quickly grown into a profound disappointment. It's something that I have come to lament nearly every day when I interact with this machine. - Air drying seems to work ok, Considering how hot the dishes get, it makes me wonder how much energy you really save with these units. I think I would still prefer a heater element in the base. - I haven't figured out a way to pause the machine and open the door without water spraying out when you open it. That might just be me. - It does in fact seem to clean dishes well enough. But it is not a magic box, and you will most likely need to remove / rinse egg yolk from your plate before you wash it -- as just on example. - The fact that it actually seems to clean the dishes to some effect, and that the drying seems to work decently, and that it really is very quiet, just makes the disappointment about the fish smell and poor rack design hit that much harder.

There are countless reports online, and discussion threads that are years long filled with people trying to solve this issue. There is no magic bullet. And if you're wondering, our filters are clean inside. The problem was present with the very first cycle. - Absolutely TERRIBLE RACK DESIGN. Just awful. Like how can wirecutter praise these machines? It is designed to be used in a very specific way. The bottom really only works well if you have a lots of plates and thin bowls. That is just not our use pattern. We use lots of cups, deep bowls, pots, mugs, bakeware, and cheap storage ware. Because the design is so single-minded, we can only load approximately half the dishes compared to our old machine. Also note that one of the mounting clips for the moveable tines began to break within the first 3 weeks because it is apparently *very* easy to move the moveable tine in the wrong direction? Other notes:- I am coming from 26 year old kenmore with the rotating timer, a heating element, and the big lever handle that you flip from left to right to lock and turn on the machine. That machine began to die all at once. IT could have been saved, but it would have cost as much as this new dishwasher. - Sometimes new is nice. And while I didn't pick it out -- my landlord did -- I may have very well ended up selecting this unit based on the reviews. I was really looking forward to this machine. But that anticipation has quickly grown into a profound disappointment. It's something that I have come to lament nearly every day when I interact with this machine. - Air drying seems to work ok, Considering how hot the dishes get, it makes me wonder how much energy you really save with these units. I think I would still prefer a heater element in the base. - I haven't figured out a way to pause the machine and open the door without water spraying out when you open it. That might just be me. - It does in fact seem to clean dishes well enough. I would prefer to have my 26 year-old Kenmore back, if I could. Two major issues:- DEAD FISH SMELL - I will note that this problem is not unique to this dishwasher -- it appears to be endemic to countless modern dishwashers, but this unit definitely has it. The issue is that the dishes end up smelling like dead fish. It is often so strong that I cannot eat from those dishes without *thoroughly* hand washing them again first. There are countless reports online, and discussion threads that are years long filled with people trying to solve this issue. There is no magic bullet. People have reported success with a variety of techniques, some only partial success, some have never been able to solve the issue, and some will purchase a different dishwasher with their fingers crossed. And if you're wondering, our filters are clean inside. The problem was present with the very first cycle. - Absolutely TERRIBLE RACK DESIGN. Just awful. Like how can wirecutter praise these machines? It is designed to be used in a very specific way. The bottom really only works well if you have a lots of plates and thin bowls. That is just not our use pattern. We use lots of cups, deep bowls, pots, mugs, bakeware, and cheap storage ware. Because the design is so single-minded, we can only load approximately half the dishes compared to our old machine. Also note that one of the mounting clips for the moveable tines began to break within the first 3 weeks because it is apparently *very* easy to move the moveable tine in the wrong direction? Other notes:- I am coming from 26 year old kenmore with the rotating timer, a heating element, and the big lever handle that you flip from left to right to lock and turn on the machine. That machine began to die all at once. IT could have been saved, but it would have cost as much as this new dishwasher. - Sometimes new is nice. And while I didn't pick it out -- my landlord did -- I may have very well ended up selecting this unit based on the reviews. I was really looking forward to this machine. But that anticipation has quickly grown into a profound disappointment. It's something that I have come to lament nearly every day when I interact with this machine. - Air drying seems to work ok, Considering how hot the dishes get, it makes me wonder how much energy you really save with these units. I think I would still prefer a heater element in the base. - I haven't figured out a way to pause the machine and open the door without water spraying out when you open it. That might just be me. - It does in fact seem to clean dishes well enough. But it is not a magic box, and you will most likely need to remove / rinse egg yolk from your plate before you wash it -- as just on example.- The fact that it actually seems to clean the dishes to some effect, and that the drying seems to work decently, and that it really is very quiet, just makes the disappointment about the fish smell and poor rack design hit that much harder.

Sentence (English): Since purchasing our very 1st home last year with my husband, it's been my dream to upgrade my kitchen appliance with Samsung.
Comments (English): [ Best upgrade in the house!  ] || ---------------- || Since purchasing our very 1st home last year with my husband, it's been my dream to upgrade my kitchen appliance with Samsung. Samsung BESpoke dishwasher has been the best upgrade to our home by replacing our old junk with a brand new one with white glass. Super easy to clean the front of the glass, easy to use. This new Samsung Bespoke Smart 46 dBA Dishwasher with StormWash has been a dream, with so many features and it connects to our phone! I love the 3 layer sections. I use the top for the kitchen utensils, the 2nd for cups, bowls, or kitchen utensils I can't fit on the 1st tray, wine glasses, small dessert plates, serving bowls, and kids cups.3rd level I use pots, pans, big plates, and silverware. I love how you can separate each piece and really get it washed properly, or lift it up and put garlic press, or spatula. The StormWash is great for cleaning those big pots and pans. The design is modern, classy, upscale, and very unique(as I can select what color I wish to have for the dishwasher). Being a family of 5, 3 boys(3,6,9 and 2 cats). I do a lot of cleaning, cooking and definitely use the dishwasher often throughout the day. I love that I can connect to my phone via wifi and know when it's done. Delay dishwashing while the boys shower as well as run it anytime, it's super quiet! Huge winner in my books! One of my favorite parts (which I thought my husband was pranking me) was it opens up once it's done to release all the air which prevents mold, wet dishes staying in and so much more! I love being able to go on a walk with my neighbors in the morning, run the dishwasher and while on my walk I get an alert on my phone when the cycle is complete. There are various modes (auto which I use often, normal, heavy, delicate, express 60, pre blast, download cycle, storm wash, lower rack(great for bazillion water bottles my boys love to go through), sanitize, high temperature). As well as lock mode, great for those little fingers who love to pray jokes on mommy(3 and 6 year old haha). I love the sleek design and the control panel hidden from those little fingers. Very smart and well thought out! I highly recommend this dishwasher based on my own positive experience! It has a stainless steel interior which is great and easy to add tabs, detergent, or liquid detergent to the detergent compartment. Adjacent to that, it has a rinse aid compartment marked with a max fill line for easy fill. Great quality product.

Sentence (English): I bought this about 3 weeks ago and it is replacing a Bosch dishwasher that came with this house when we moved in.
Comments (English): [ A Welcome Change ] || ---------------- || I bought this about 3 weeks ago and it is replacing a Bosch dishwasher that came with this house when we moved in. I was never thrilled with the Bosch because of the configuration of the rack prongs on the bottom rack. The prongs were too close together to easily fit the dirty dishes in place. Then I got my KitchenAid and I am in heaven. The prongs are equi-distant on the racks and it makes it so much easier to fit the dirty dishes in place. It actually seems like my new dishwasher holds more dishes. The only down side is that the holes for the silverware are several different sizes--so I have to try to see which size will hold the slightly different sizes of my silverware handles. Another plus is that the machine is very, very quiet.

Then I got my KitchenAid and I am in heaven. The prongs are equi-distant on the racks and it makes it so much easier to fit the dirty dishes in place. The only down side is that the holes for the silverware are several different sizes--so I have to try to see which size will hold the slightly different sizes of my silverware handles. Another plus is that the machine is very, very quiet.

Sentence (English): Rocket Installation.
Comments (English): [ My first time using a dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || Rocket Installation. Installation was completed despite the Chuseok holiday. They scheduled the appointment very quickly. They arrived at the promised time, installed it immediately, and were very kind. Product Review. 23.08.10 It was a recently manufactured product. However, when I looked at the door to try using it after installation, I discovered a scratch. It is quite disappointing that I discovered it less than an hour after installation, but for now, I will just use it as is. Usage Review (Installation 23.10.02). When the dishwasher is running, the water makes a bubbling sound. It sounds like water draining from a washing machine continuously. It is difficult to compare as I haven't used other dishwashers, but it doesn't seem to be on the quiet side. Since this is a model recommended by many people around me, I am using it well without any issues with washing or drying. I will add to the review after using it for a week! 23.10.20 Update. I plan to write a little more about the review after using it. First of all, the day after installation, water started leaking through the kitchen floorboards. I inquired with the apartment management office, and they said it was because the water pipe bolts were not tightened properly. Since October 3rd was National Foundation Day, I couldn't contact the assigned installation technician immediately. When I reached out on October 4th, he said he would visit again to check, and he did so. Please make sure to request once more that the bolts be tightened securely after installation. Secondly, there was standing water on the stainless steel inside the dishwasher. Worried about stains, I tried wiping it with a paper towel, but polishing powder came off right away. I was so shocked! I realized, "Ah, this is stainless steel, too. I need to polish it with oil." I was surprised by how much polishing powder came off, considering it is an appliance. I am also uploading a photo of the water stains after wiping them with oil. Please make sure to clean off the polishing powder before use. Thirdly, the door opens slightly after the cycle ends. Comments (English): [ I am 80% free from breast milk. ] || ---------------- || Even though I am in my mid-60s, I had never even considered or used a dishwasher. I just thought, "What's the big deal about washing dishes?" However, since a family of four wakes up and eats at different times, the pile of dishes keeps growing, and empty cups and other items keep piling up, leaving no time for my hands to dry. If I take a brief break and turn around, there is already a pile of dishes waiting. While I only need to run the washing machine once a day, dishes pile up more than three times a day, so I figured I would break even if I only used it for a month. That's why I decided to install a dishwasher, despite my small kitchen. I looked for a 6-place setting to fit my family, a countertop model rather than a built-in one, and one that would fit the sink size. I found a Samsung product that fit perfectly, and to make matters worse, the price was just right. Luckily, I even got a 7% card discount. I applied on September 29th, and even though it was during the Chuseok holiday, the delivery and installation date was listed as October 2nd. On October 2nd, the delivery driver arrived and initially said the space wouldn't work because it was too narrow (the artificial stone countertop had a raised edge against the wall). However, the dishwasher's bottom and back sections recede about 5cm (allowing the pipes to be pulled out and disposed of), making it a 100% perfect fit for the location. Eventually, the installation went smoothly, and after receiving a brief explanation and the technician left, I started a test run with a load of dishes. It ran about 5 washes in total (including 5 draining cycles), and the amount of water used was truly only about two standard dishwashing basins. If I were to do it myself, I would squeeze in a lot of detergent and leave the tap running almost constantly, so I think I would use over 10 basins. About 3 minutes before finishing, the lid opens to let the hot steam escape, and you just take the dishes out and clean up after a while, and that's it. The dishwashing quality is excellent. They shine and are cleaner than when I washed them by hand. Comments (English): I am using an LG Objet dishwasher. I knew that a dishwasher was convenient, but my mother told me that I would have to wash the first dishes anyway and that washing them by hand was the same, so I just believed her and washed dishes by hand for about two years even after giving birth. Then, it was so difficult that I bought it when I moved in 2021. I've been using it for over 2 years now. Before I bought a dishwasher, it was a battle with dishwashing. Even if you don’t do the dishes, you save an hour a day. Anyone who has ever washed dishes knows that during the holidays, a lot of dishes pile up and you have to do them several times a day and it takes a long time. Then, my back hurts, my neck hurts, and my kid is looking for his mom. So when I finally moved, I made a space for a dishwasher and bought it. I felt that the dishwasher was as essential an appliance as a vacuum cleaner or a washing machine. It wasn't true that they were the same because of my mother's dishwashing. For people like me who are a bit picky, it takes a long time to wash dishes, but if you press the safe rinse mode button, it somehow feels cleaner than when I do it. As long as there are no hard food residues stuck to it, all dirt such as sticky, slippery, oil, etc. will become sticky. Holiday foods are often greasy, but they are all dry. And I hate washing dishes the most, but during holidays, people gather together, use a lot of cups, and drink coffee after meals, so I used to sigh, but now I feel so good when I put cups in the dishwasher. And here's a tip: Some people pile up the dishes in the dishwasher and put them in the dishwasher all at once in the evening, but don't do that. Just wipe off the residue and put them in the dishwasher one by one. I thought it would not be easy to clean once the moisture dries, but the LG was able to clean easily due to the high temperature. The first reason I chose LG dishwasher is because of its design. The LG object was also the prettiest at the time. It's still the prettiest. Secondly, the washing temperature is high, so it cleans well, and the True Steam function makes it safe to wash baby products. It also has a virus sterilization function, so there is no need to purchase a separate machine such as a baby bottle sterilizer. Thirdly, the LG brand itself was used by me while I was living alone and married, and there were no problems compared to other brands. Some brands say you have to be good at pulling, but I'm not good at pulling, so if it breaks while using it, it's very inconvenient. After using it myself, I learned why adults like LG and why it is a world-recognized brand, and I always use LG when it comes to home appliances.^^ They are sturdy and functional. Anyway, LG is the best and I highly recommend LG dishwasher. I also recommend it to people around me. I knew that a dishwasher was convenient, but my mother told me that I would have to wash the first dishes anyway and that washing them by hand was the same, so I just believed her and washed dishes by hand for about two years even after giving birth. Then, it was so difficult that I bought it when I moved in 2021. I've been using it for over 2 years now. Before I bought a dishwasher, it was a battle with dishwashing. Even if you don’t do the dishes, you save an hour a day. Anyone who has ever washed dishes knows that during the holidays, a lot of dishes pile up and you have to do them several times a day and it takes a long time. Then, my back hurts, my neck hurts, and my kid is looking for his mom. So when I finally moved, I made a space for a dishwasher and bought it. I felt that the dishwasher was as essential an appliance as a vacuum cleaner or a washing machine. It wasn't true that they were the same because of my mother's dishwashing. For people like me who are a bit picky, it takes a long time to wash dishes, but if you press the safe rinse mode button, it somehow feels cleaner than when I do it. As long as there are no hard food residues stuck to it, all dirt such as sticky, slippery, oil, etc. will become sticky. Holiday foods are often greasy, but they are all dry. And I hate washing dishes the most, but during holidays, people gather together, use a lot of cups, and drink coffee after meals, so I used to sigh, but now I feel so good when I put cups in the dishwasher. And here's a tip: Some people pile up the dishes in the dishwasher and put them in the dishwasher all at once in the evening, but don't do that. Just wipe off the residue and put them in the dishwasher one by one. I thought it would not be easy to clean once the moisture dries, but the LG was able to clean easily due to the high temperature. The first reason I chose LG dishwasher is because of its design. The LG object was also the prettiest at the time. It's still the prettiest. Secondly, the washing temperature is high, so it cleans well, and the True Steam function makes it safe to wash baby products. It also has a virus sterilization function, so there is no need to purchase a separate machine such as a baby bottle sterilizer. Thirdly, the LG brand itself was used by me while I was living alone and married, and there were no problems compared to other brands. Some brands say you have to be good at pulling, but I'm not good at pulling, so if it breaks while using it, it's very inconvenient. After using it myself, I learned why adults like LG and why it is a world-recognized brand, and I always use LG when it comes to home appliances.^^ They are sturdy and functional. Anyway, LG is the best and I highly recommend LG dishwasher. I also recommend it to people around me. I'm sure everyone has a lot of concerns when buying for the first time, so I hope my article will help you make a choice, and I'll end this review. I hope everyone’s family is filled with happiness and peace.
Comments (Original): 엘지 오브제 식기세척기 사용하고 있어요.식기세척기 편하다는 건 알고있었지만 친정엄마가 어차피 애벌설거지도 해야하고 손가는 건 똑같다고 해서 그말만 믿고 애낳고도 2년정도 손설거지했어요. 그러다가 너무 힘들어서 2021년 이사올 때 구입했어요. 그렇게 지금 2년넘게 사용중이에요.식기세척기 사기 전에는 설거지와의 전쟁이었어요. 설거지만 없어도 하루에 한시간은 절약되거든요. 설거지 해보신 분들은 아시겠지만 명절에는 설거지가 엄청나게 많이 쌓이고 하루에 몇번씩 해야하며 시간도 오래 걸리잖아요.. 그러다보면 허리도 아프고 목도 아프고 애도 엄마 찾고..ㅜㅜ그래서 결국 이사할 때 식기세척기자리 만들어서 사넣었어요. 식기세척기는 청소기나 세탁기만큼이나 필수가전이라는 걸 느꼈습니다.친정엄마의 애벌설거지때문에 똑같다는 말은 사실이 아니었어요. 저처럼 약간 결벽증이 있는 사람들은 설거지도 오래 걸리는데 안심헹굼모드버튼 누르면 왠지 제가 하는 거보다 더 깔끔한 거 같습니다. 딱딱한 음식찌꺼기만 안붙어있으면 끈적이거나 미끄덩한 기름기 등등 모든 더러움들 다 뽀득뽀득 해지고요.명절음식들은 기름진 게 많은데 그냥 싹 다 뽀드득이에요.그리고 저는 컵설거지를 가장 싫어하는데 명절엔 사람이 모이고 컵도 많이 쓰고 식후에 커피도 마셔서 예전엔 한숨이 나왔다면 지금은 식기세척기에 컵을 넣을때 기분이 그렇게 좋아요..그리고 팁을 드리자면 설거지통에 쌓아뒀다가 저녁에 한꺼번에 식기세척기 넣는 분들도 계신데 그렇게 하지마시고 그냥 찌꺼기만 닦아서 식기세척기에 차곡차곡 그때그때 넣어두세요. 물기가 마르면 잘 안닦일 거라 생각했지만 엘지는 온도가 높아서 그런지 잘 닦이더라고요.제가 엘지 식기세척기로 선택한 이유는 첫번째로 디자인적 요소입니다. 엘지 오브제가 당시에 제일 예쁘기도 했고.. 지금도 제일 예쁩니다. 두번째로는 세척온도가 높아서 잘닦이고 트루스팀기능이 아기용품을 세척하는데 안심이 되기 때문입니다. 바이러스살균기능도 있어서 젖병소독기같은 기계를 따로 구입할 필요가 없어요.세번째로 그냥 엘지라는 브랜드자체가 제가 자취생활+혼인기간동안 직접 사용해보니 타브랜드보다 고장이 없더라고요. 어떤 브랜드는 뽑기를 잘해야한다고 하는데 전 뽑기를 못해서 그런가 사용하다가 고장나면 너무 불편하더라고요. 왜 어른들이 엘지를 좋아하는 지 왜 세계에서 인정받는 브랜드인지 직접 사용해보니 알게되었고 저는 가전은 무조건 엘지로 해요^^ 튼튼하고 기능에 충실하거든요.여튼 엘지최고고 엘지식세기 강추합니다. 제 주변에도 추천하고 다녀요. 다들 처음 살 때 고민이 많으실텐데 제 글이 선택에 도움이 되셨기를 바라며 후기를 마칩니다. 다들 가정에 행복과 평안이 가득하길 빕니다.

Comments (English): I am using an LG Objet dishwasher. I knew that a dishwasher was convenient, but my mother told me that I would have to wash the first dishes anyway and that washing them by hand was the same, so I just believed her and washed dishes by hand for about two years even after giving birth. Even if you don’t do the dishes, you save an hour a day. Anyone who has ever washed dishes knows that during the holidays, a lot of dishes pile up and you have to do them several times a day and it takes a long time. Then, my back hurts, my neck hurts, and my kid is looking for his mom. So when I finally moved, I made a space for a dishwasher and bought it. I felt that the dishwasher was as essential an appliance as a vacuum cleaner or a washing machine. It wasn't true that they were the same because of my mother's dishwashing. And I hate washing dishes the most, but during holidays, people gather together, use a lot of cups, and drink coffee after meals, so I used to sigh, but now I feel so good when I put cups in the dishwasher. And here's a tip: Some people pile up the dishes in the dishwasher and put them in the dishwasher all at once in the evening, but don't do that. Just wipe off the residue and put them in the dishwasher one by one. I thought it would not be easy to clean once the moisture dries, but the LG was able to clean easily due to the high temperature. The first reason I chose LG dishwasher is because of its design. The LG object was also the prettiest at the time. It's still the prettiest. Secondly, the washing temperature is high, so it cleans well, and the True Steam function makes it safe to wash baby products. It also has a virus sterilization function, so there is no need to purchase a separate machine such as a baby bottle sterilizer. Thirdly, the LG brand itself was used by me while I was living alone and married, and there were no problems compared to other brands. Some brands say you have to be good at pulling, but I'm not good at pulling, so if it breaks while using it, it's very inconvenient. After using it myself, I learned why adults like LG and why it is a world-recognized brand, and I always use LG when it comes to home appliances.^^ They are sturdy and functional. Anyway, LG is the best and I highly recommend LG dishwasher. I also recommend it to people around me. I'm sure everyone has a lot of concerns when buying for the first time, so I hope my article will help you make a choice, and I'll end this review. I hope everyone’s family is filled with happiness and peace.

I knew that a dishwasher was convenient, but my mother told me that I would have to wash the first dishes anyway and that washing them by hand was the same, so I just believed her and washed dishes by hand for about two years even after giving birth. Then, it was so difficult that I bought it when I moved in 2021. I've been using it for over 2 years now. Before I bought a dishwasher, it was a battle with dishwashing. Even if you don’t do the dishes, you save an hour a day. Anyone who has ever washed dishes knows that during the holidays, a lot of dishes pile up and you have to do them several times a day and it takes a long time. Then, my back hurts, my neck hurts, and my kid is looking for his mom. So when I finally moved, I made a space for a dishwasher and bought it. I felt that the dishwasher was as essential an appliance as a vacuum cleaner or a washing machine. It wasn't true that they were the same because of my mother's dishwashing. For people like me who are a bit picky, it takes a long time to wash dishes, but if you press the safe rinse mode button, it somehow feels cleaner than when I do it. As long as there are no hard food residues stuck to it, all dirt such as sticky, slippery, oil, etc. will become sticky. Holiday foods are often greasy, but they are all dry. And I hate washing dishes the most, but during holidays, people gather together, use a lot of cups, and drink coffee after meals, so I used to sigh, but now I feel so good when I put cups in the dishwasher. And here's a tip: Some people pile up the dishes in the dishwasher and put them in the dishwasher all at once in the evening, but don't do that. Just wipe off the residue and put them in the dishwasher one by one. I thought it would not be easy to clean once the moisture dries, but the LG was able to clean easily due to the high temperature. The first reason I chose LG dishwasher is because of its design. The LG object was also the prettiest at the time. It's still the prettiest. Secondly, the washing temperature is high, so it cleans well, and the True Steam function makes it safe to wash baby products. It also has a virus sterilization function, so there is no need to purchase a separate machine such as a baby bottle sterilizer. Thirdly, the LG brand itself was used by me while I was living alone and married, and there were no problems compared to other brands. Some brands say you have to be good at pulling, but I'm not good at pulling, so if it breaks while using it, it's very inconvenient. After using it myself, I learned why adults like LG and why it is a world-recognized brand, and I always use LG when it comes to home appliances.^^ They are sturdy and functional. Anyway, LG is the best and I highly recommend LG dishwasher. I also recommend it to people around me. I'm sure everyone has a lot of concerns when buying for the first time, so I hope my article will help you make a choice, and I'll end this review. I hope everyone’s family is filled with happiness and peace.
Comments (Original): 엘지 오브제 식기세척기 사용하고 있어요.식기세척기 편하다는 건 알고있었지만 친정엄마가 어차피 애벌설거지도 해야하고 손가는 건 똑같다고 해서 그말만 믿고 애낳고도 2년정도 손설거지했어요. 그러다가 너무 힘들어서 2021년 이사올 때 구입했어요. 그렇게 지금 2년넘게 사용중이에요.식기세척기 사기 전에는 설거지와의 전쟁이었어요. 설거지만 없어도 하루에 한시간은 절약되거든요. 설거지 해보신 분들은 아시겠지만 명절에는 설거지가 엄청나게 많이 쌓이고 하루에 몇번씩 해야하며 시간도 오래 걸리잖아요.. 그러다보면 허리도 아프고 목도 아프고 애도 엄마 찾고..ㅜㅜ그래서 결국 이사할 때 식기세척기자리 만들어서 사넣었어요. 식기세척기는 청소기나 세탁기만큼이나 필수가전이라는 걸 느꼈습니다.친정엄마의 애벌설거지때문에 똑같다는 말은 사실이 아니었어요. 저처럼 약간 결벽증이 있는 사람들은 설거지도 오래 걸리는데 안심헹굼모드버튼 누르면 왠지 제가 하는 거보다 더 깔끔한 거 같습니다. 딱딱한 음식찌꺼기만 안붙어있으면 끈적이거나 미끄덩한 기름기 등등 모든 더러움들 다 뽀득뽀득 해지고요.명절음식들은 기름진 게 많은데 그냥 싹 다 뽀드득이에요.그리고 저는 컵설거지를 가장 싫어하는데 명절엔 사람이 모이고 컵도 많이 쓰고 식후에 커피도 마셔서 예전엔 한숨이 나왔다면 지금은 식기세척기에 컵을 넣을때 기분이 그렇게 좋아요..그리고 팁을 드리자면 설거지통에 쌓아뒀다가 저녁에 한꺼번에 식기세척기 넣는 분들도 계신데 그렇게 하지마시고 그냥 찌꺼기만 닦아서 식기세척기에 차곡차곡 그때그때 넣어두세요. 물기가 마르면 잘 안닦일 거라 생각했지만 엘지는 온도가 높아서 그런지 잘 닦이더라고요.제가 엘지 식기세척기로 선택한 이유는 첫번째로 디자인적 요소입니다. 엘지 오브제가 당시에 제일 예쁘기도 했고.. 지금도 제일 예쁩니다. 두번째로는 세척온도가 높아서 잘닦이고 트루스팀기능이 아기용품을 세척하는데 안심이 되기 때문입니다. 바이러스살균기능도 있어서 젖병소독기같은 기계를 따로 구입할 필요가 없어요.세번째로 그냥 엘지라는 브랜드자체가 제가 자취생활+혼인기간동안 직접 사용해보니 타브랜드보다 고장이 없더라고요. 어떤 브랜드는 뽑기를 잘해야한다고 하는데 전 뽑기를 못해서 그런가 사용하다가 고장나면 너무 불편하더라고요. 왜 어른들이 엘지를 좋아하는 지 왜 세계에서 인정받는 브랜드인지 직접 사용해보니 알게되었고 저는 가전은 무조건 엘지로 해요^^ 튼튼하고 기능에 충실하거든요.여튼 엘지최고고 엘지식세기 강추합니다. 제 주변에도 추천하고 다녀요. 다들 처음 살 때 고민이 많으실텐데 제 글이 선택에 도움이 되셨기를 바라며 후기를 마칩니다. 다들 가정에 행복과 평안이 가득하길 빕니다.

Sentence (English): I'm so grateful for the dishwasher because I can escape from dishwashing hell with just a dishwasher!
Comments (English): ========================================================= Making holiday food and setting the table for guests during the Chuseok holiday I can't miss it when I eat with my family. I'm so grateful for the dishwasher because I can escape from dishwashing hell with just a dishwasher! First of all, I liked the hygienic 'high-temperature sterilization & steam function' the most. As I wash the dishes that many people eat, I pay more attention to sterilization, germs, and harmful bacteria. Boiling a lot of dishes and cutlery is also very cumbersome. The LG DIOS dishwasher not only provides high-temperature sterilization but also adds steam, so I can use cleanly disinfected dishes at any time without the need for sterilization in boiling water, which gives me peace of mind! In addition, the smart app function using the 'LG ThinQ App' was really convenient. It's nice that you can use the power usage without worrying about the electricity bill and set each course. I like the LG ThinQ app even more because it allows you to manage LG home appliances clearly. . -Also, each family member eats at a different pace, so if someone at home eats quickly and someone eats late, the timing for washing dishes also varies. In that case, if you use the pause function, you can meticulously remove all the dishes at any time without turning off the power, which is even more satisfying! -Also, my personal tip for using LG Dios is that it is even better if you first wash greasy dishes first! Of course, it is more convenient and better to prepare greasy dishes, such as Chuseok food, by rotating them separately for each course. Normally, washing dishes isn't that difficult, so if I just use the water pressure of the kitchen sink to gently wash off the remaining food and seasonings, even the greasy dishes can go back to the regular cycle. LG DIOS dishwasher that enriches your life! I highly recommend using the LG DIOS dishwasher, which is suitable for setting tables for many guests, as it frees you from washing dishes! ======================================================== - Blog (shared by writing a new post) / Completed with hashtags) Naver Post (Completed with sharing by writing a new post / Completed with hashtags included) Facebook (Completed with sharing by writing a new post / Completed with hashtags included) Twitter (Completed with sharing by writing a new post / Completed with hashtags included) Cafe (Completed with sharing with new posts / Complete with hashtags included) Shared by writing / Completed with hashtags)

Sentence (English): After 12 years my first Kitchen Aid decided to flood for some unknown reason.
Comments (English): [ Steam/moisture vent in front ] || ---------------- || After 12 years my first Kitchen Aid decided to flood for some unknown reason. I read all the dishwasher reviews and decided to try Kitchen Aid again mostly because I presumed I could get at least 12 years from it. I was won over when I saw the steam/moisture vent was placed in the front (COMMON SENSE). My old one vented at the side and slowly was ruining my very $$$$ custom cabinet. On the positive side, the rack adjusters seem to be engineered better this time and won't disintegrate, the racks come out smoothly, strainer at bottom is a plus, I like the little window on the rinse dispenser, and the utensil basket has a good design. I mostly look forward to having the DRIP TRAY WORK. I believe the machine is to shut down if a leak is detected. Maybe an alarm would also be helpful. I'm guessing the drip tray won't help if there's a gasket leak. I use Affresh but our water is so hard it's a battle. Hoping to wipe down gasket after use from now on. On a final note, machine is so very, very quiet I don't know it's running.

A couple of minor things that could be improved:. The door 'flops' down when opening it. We don't use the Silverware basket lids and it would be nice if the lids had a lock to keep them in the open position.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher is compact and does not take up space.
Comments (English): The dishwasher is compact and does not take up space. It is suitable for use in small kitchens in old houses. It is easy to install and can be used by placing it on the countertop and connecting it to the water pipe and power supply. It comes with a softened water system, suitable for areas with different water quality, and protects the machine from scale. The two-layer shelf can hold four rice bowls, four noodle bowls, and four plates, a total of 39 pieces. It is suitable for a family of three to four.

Comments (English): Bought this model under a Labor Day promotion to replace a 7-year old Whirlpool that started leaking and to match our GE Profile refrigerator and microwave (both purchased from Costco). After a week, we are very pleased with how quiet it is, wash quality, and capacity. We tend to use a lot of small utensils for cooking that would rob space away from the upper rack in a traditional 2-rack dishwasher. Now we can put things like spatulas, storage lids, coffee mug caps, and knives in the 3rd rack freeing up space in the second rack. The auto sensing wash mode washes our dishes about 30 minutes faster than our outgoing dishwasher (in sensor mode) and the bottle jets are great at cleaning our smoothie cups. The lower rack has two adjustable tines which allows placement of a crockpot (our old dishwasher only had one that could be lowered) when both are lowered. The one-hour wash cycle is legit and does a good job. Have not tested any of the drying cycles nor the steam option. An UltraFresh mode moves air and cycles water through the wash bay before a full wash cycle and worked well dealing with plates used for fish. The silverware basket has its own jets to ensure proper cleaning and has plenty of slots. A few things that could be better are the racking (lower and 2nd rack) is spaced further apart that limits placement of smaller items, the silverware basket rows are canted (so one row is not deep enough for our particular flatware), there are no adjustable 2nd rack tines, and we've unintentionally enabled some buttons on the top of the door (just have to learn not to touch the top of door when loading/unloading). Lastly, Costco's contractor installed the dishwasher with no issues. So far very pleased with our purchase and would recommend this model.

Sentence (English): The machine itself is excellent, but I would not recommend buying appliances from Home Depot.
Comments (English): The machine itself is excellent, but I would not recommend buying appliances from Home Depot. We PCS'd and decided to upgrade. We paid the extra fee for installation + disposal of our old dishwasher. The crew improperly connected the water line to the unit, leaving a large kink in the line. The installation tech called the next customer letting them know they were on their way. The test wash was unsuccessful, they left saying "you have 48 hours to call HD for a replacement." After calling HD, we had to wait over a week for another crew to bring the replacement. The crew examined the connections and said "we can't fix it, HD will call you within 24 hours to send out a plumber." That was over a month ago and I still have not been contacted. I ended up using my own money to replace the damaged water line. It is evident HD has little regard for their customers, and I would recommend my fellow military members to order their appliances elsewhere from a reputable company who values accountability.

Comments (English): [ 1 star PURELY for customer service & initial issue ] || ---------------- || Wifey and I did a bunch of research in trying to find a decent replacement for our very old & dying dishwasher. Between Wirecutter & the plethora of reviews, we decided to go with this one, and we had a few huge issues people should know about: -First, we had a leak within the first two months of using it. Initially it seemed like a one-off issue, but after a few weeks it happened again. Contacted Costco support and they helped connect us with Whirlpool support. They sent out a technician who supposedly fixed the problem. -Within a few weeks we had yet another issue, somehow this time even bigger than before; contacted the same teams, got another technician, and that theoretically fixed our problems. The biggest issue, though, is that now our floors around the dishwasher have warped and need to be completely repaired; this kicked off a months-long battle with Whirlpool's Claims Dept., which has been the most frustrating customer service experience I've ever had. They denied any problems, made me jump through countless hoops (required multiple bids for floor replacement, pictures, pictures again, complete lack of replies to my messages) and just generally made for the worst experience I've ever had with a company. The woman from Whirlpool handling this claim eventually told me to contact my home insurance to work through this, and while I've been able to get more support from them, I need to absolutely warn everyone to NOT buy a Whirlpool product purely on the basis of their "support" and lack of care for their customers.

Sentence (English): Average is the right word for this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Average at best. ] || ---------------- || Average is the right word for this dishwasher. Best thing about it is, it's quieter than my previous GE dishwasher. However, I insisted the installers use the old blanket from previous dishwasher as this model came with none. also, this dishwasher doesn't really dry dishes, which I think odd, since it has a 'dry boost' function - have had it two weeks and no load has been dry yet. Door is flimsy. Comparing to my previous dishwasher, which finally bit the dust 6 months after warranty, this is much less sturdy. All that said, I shopped over the phone with the dealer, the price of dishwashers has increased so much, and it's such a hassle scheduling installers, etc., that I'm just gonna tough it out, keep dishtowels within reach when I open up the completed cycle, and shop more carefully next time. Sentence (English): I purchased the Bosch 800 Series 18" Dishwasher (SPE68U55UC) back in February 2017 and, I must say, my initial experience during the warranty period was excellent.
Comments (English): [ Frequent breakdowns and costly repairs ] || ---------------- || I purchased the Bosch 800 Series 18" Dishwasher (SPE68U55UC) back in February 2017 and, I must say, my initial experience during the warranty period was excellent. For a dishwasher that's only six years old and has consistently failed to perform reliably, this seems like an unreasonable expense.While I understand that not every product will have issues, my experience with this Bosch dishwasher has been nothing short of frustrating and costly. I hope your experience with Bosch dishwashers is better, but if you happen to get a lemon like I did, be prepared for expensive and recurring repairs.

Sentence (English): We've had this dishwasher for about a month now and are very happy with it.
Comments (English): [ Excellent dishwasher, but no "clean" indicator :( ] || ---------------- || We've had this dishwasher for about a month now and are very happy with it. The dishes have never been so clean and sparkly and it's extremely quiet! The racks are cleverly designed to help things dry better. We're able to wash many things that would not get clean in our prior dishwasher, including pots, pans, casserole dishes, anything with avocado on it, and more. L\\Also love the silverware rack. My only complaint is that there is no \"clean\" indicator that remains on until you open the dishwasher to empty it. It displays that the cycle is over for about 20 minutes, but after that you are out of luck. Was hoping it was a setting that could be changed on the HomeConnect app, but no such luck. This is a real miss and I took one star off for it. Otherwise very happy with it!

I did a lot of research, poring over reviews by customers and those by expert panels, and decided to go with this LG dishwasher. Comments (English): [ More then expected. ] || ---------------- || I don't do reviews but this is my second Bosch DW. The first was a lower end DW, sixteen years ago. I liked it. The deep bottom rack nicely handles larger pots, fry pans while still having room for the usual plates, bowls, etc. of the meal prep. Silver ware top rack is way to go. Don't even need the basket for odd stuff as they lay nicely in the middle rack while the cups, glasses and the odd container sit on top of them. Plenty of room. Oh, and everything comes out nicely clean and dry. Well done engineers. Thanks

Sentence (English): We've had this dishwasher for about a month now and are very happy with it.
Comments (English): [ Excellent dishwasher, but no "clean" indicator :( ] || ---------------- || We've had this dishwasher for about a month now and are very happy with it. The dishes have never been so clean and sparkly and it's extremely quiet! The racks are cleverly designed to help things dry better. We're able to wash many things that would not get clean in our prior dishwasher, including pots, pans, casserole dishes, anything with avocado on it, and more. L\Also love the silverware rack. My only complaint is that there is no "clean" indicator that remains on until you open the dishwasher to empty it. It displays that the cycle is over for about 20 minutes, but after that you are out of luck. Was hoping it was a setting that could be changed on the HomeConnect app, but no such luck. This is a real miss and I took one star off for it. Otherwise very happy with it!

Sentence (English): I ordered this trusting Samsung.
Comments (English): I ordered this trusting Samsung. The design is sleek and the size is just right. However, it is a bit disappointing that it lacks features like an extra rinse cycle or other detailed functions. It takes about 20 minutes including drying on the standard setting. The quick setting finishes quickly, but it finishes so quickly that I feel uneasy about it, so I end up using the standard setting. Also, I understand this product was first manufactured in 2021, but I ordered it assuming it was the 2023 model released this year. However, after installation, I found that a unit manufactured in November 2022 arrived. Looking at other people's reviews, it seems they received a 2023 model.

I ended up using my own money to replace the damaged water line. It is evident HD has little regard for their customers, and I would recommend my fellow military members to order their appliances elsewhere from a reputable company who values accountability.

Sentence (English): This product was purchased primarily because it's quiet.
Comments (English): [ It is worth your sanity to run a quiet dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || This product was purchased primarily because it's quiet. It was surprising just how quiet, but the sound barrier around it makes it the best! I reviewed Consumer Reports which recommended the Bosch dishwashers and found they were right. I would prefer a unit that does not have the controls hidden and that would display the time left on the cycle, but there is so much to appreciate on this unit. You can auto dry which pops the door open to let the steam out, or you can run it where you can see how long it will take, it will make an audible feedback at finish, and you can pop the door and turn off the cycle in that manner to save some electricity from the auto door pop. I have used normal, auto, and heavy once and all cleaned well. I also did not believe I would like the silverware try but I have come to love it! The knife (or flatware baskets) are cheesily made but you don't even have to use them if you put everything in the highest flat rack. LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS DISHWASHER.

Sentence (English): As a busy housewife, I have been looking for a dishwasher that can easily solve the problem of washing dishes after meals.
Comments (English): As a busy housewife, I have been looking for a dishwasher that can easily solve the problem of washing dishes after meals. Recently, I purchased a Haier W30 dishwasher, which really gave me an unexpectedly efficient dishwashing experience! First of all, I want to praise its door-opening and quick-drying function. I was very pleasantly surprised by the quick-drying design of this dishwasher. After washing the dishes, you only need to wait for a moment, and the door of the dishwasher will automatically open, quickly dissipating the residual heat and allowing the dishes to dry quickly. This is really convenient for me. I don’t have to wait for the dishes to dry naturally, which saves time and effort! In addition, the zoned washing function of Haier W30 dishwasher is also very practical. It has multiple dishwashing areas, which can carry out reasonable partition washing according to different tableware sizes and materials. In this way, I can wash different types of tableware at the same time, such as bowls, plates, cups, etc., without worrying about collisions between them or poor cleaning results. This is really an intelligent design that saves me the trouble of washing dishes by hand.
Comments (Original): 作为一位忙碌的家庭主妇，我一直在寻找一款能够轻松解决餐后洗碗问题的洗碗机。最近，我购买了海尔W30洗碗机，它真的给了我一个出乎意料的高效洗碗体验！首先，我要夸赞一下它的开门速干功能。这款洗碗机的开门速干设计让我非常惊喜。在洗碗完成后，只需稍微等待一会儿，洗碗机的门就会自动打开，快速将余温散发出来，让碗碟迅速变干。这对于我来说真是太方便了，不用再等待碗碟自然晾干，省时省力！另外，海尔W30洗碗机的分区洗功能也非常实用。它拥有多个洗碗区域，可以根据不同的餐具大小和材质进行合理的分区洗涤。这样一来，我可以同时清洗不同类型的餐具，如碗、盘子、杯子等，而不用担心它们之间的碰撞或者清洗效果不佳。这真是一种智能化的设计，让我省去了手洗餐具的烦恼。

Sentence (English): This is a super quiet machine.
Comments (English): [ Quietest dishwasher I have ever had ] || ---------------- || This is a super quiet machine. I always have to double-check to make sure it is really on. This is one of the main reasons I give it a positive rating--I love it. The dishes are clean which is of course the main factor I look at, but I have had a few dishes come out with some food still attached. This is perhaps due to it taking a while for me to discover the best way to load the racks. Some of the racks have tines that slant the wrong way or are too close together--though I have learned to lay flat the movable tines. I still have trouble putting in sheet pans, which don't fit well. The third rack for cutlery is kind of nice though a little finicky--you carefully slot each individual piece into its spot, instead of dumping them by handfuls into the basket. All of these complaints however are quite minor and probably due to the fact this is my first new dishwasher in 20 years--it takes a while to get used to it. I really do like it and would recommend it to anyone.

Sentence (English): My least favorite chore for as long as I can remember has been emptying the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Favorite chore ever ] || ---------------- || My least favorite chore for as long as I can remember has been emptying the dishwasher. When we bought our new home we didn't upgrade the dishwasher because we were on a tight budget. When the old dishwasher began to have problems we decided to replace it with a new one. I have many friends and family members that have Bosch dishwashers and have said they are the best dishwashers they have ever had. I did my research and knew we would be buying a Bosch after doing some comparisons. The only question was which model do we get? I am a recent organ recipient and when I read that the 800 series had a sanitary cycle well that cinched it forme. We have had our lovely dishwasher now for about 3 months and I can honestly say I really love it! For the first time EVER I'm quick to empty the dishwasher. My dishes are sparkling, even some of my older utensils look better coming out of this new machine. Not having to do a pre-rinse on my plates is literally a dream come true. The door to this machine is solid! It's beautifully made! I think my favorite part of this dishwasher is the third rack for utensils. This third rack is a gift from the heavens! It may sound like I'm going on and on about a dishwasher, okay you get it, I like it! Like I said earlier, I love this dishwasher and now emptying the dishwasher is my favorite chore!

Comments (English): [ Cleans well but finish is peeling off ] || ---------------- || I have had this dishwasher for about 15 months. I have been happy with the performance - for the most part, the dishwasher cleans and dries dishes very well and is fairly quiet. However, I recently noticed that the PrintShield finish on the front of the machine is beginning to peel off slightly at the bottom. I contacted KitchenAid about this and was told that this is a cosmetic issue and is not covered under the warranty. Given that this is a $1300 dishwasher, I think it's unacceptable that the finish is peeling off this quickly and that KitchenAid will not fix the issue. Based on this, I would not recommend this dishwasher, at least with the stainless steel PrintShield finish.

Sentence (English): To sum up, I am very satisfied.
Comments (English): [ It's the best ] || ---------------- || To sum up, I am very satisfied. I have been using the dishwasher for 12 people since I got married 15 years ago. The existing product was broken and I tried to fix it, but the repair cost was high and it was old, so I have been looking for a replacement for several months. In fact, it is L Company. I was quite concerned about the 100 degree Celsius Truth Team and this model that sticks to the basics and has an automatic door opening. The price difference was significant, but since I tend to buy good things when I buy them, I was leaning towards the L company. Meanwhile, this product was sold at a special price, including small and medium-sized businesses. So it was the cheapest among all products for 12 people or more. In fact, the existing product only used automatic functions rather than additional functions, so I bought it right away because it was less than half the price. The product was a basic model, so there didn't seem to be much difference in appearance or function from the model from 15 years ago. However, when using it for the first time, it was so quiet that my wife asked why the dishwasher wouldn't start. The existing model made a spinning and draining noise. Still, I was satisfied with just being free from dishwashing, and I don't know if it was because the dishwasher worked well or because it was a new product, but it was quieter than a washing machine or dryer. The delivery drivers were also very kind and grateful. I purchased a freestanding stand for veranda installation, but it was in an area where installation was not allowed, so I brought the product and left in vain. However, the very next day, they sent a built-in technician and installed it as quickly as possible. I was satisfied with everything from the product to the installation, but one thing that was disappointing was that although it was a basic model, the interior finish was not typical of Samsung. Still, considering the price, I was satisfied with my shopping~~^^

Comments (English): [ It's the best ] || ---------------- || To sum up, I am very satisfied. I have been using the dishwasher for 12 people since I got married 15 years ago. The existing product was broken and I tried to fix it, but the repair cost was high and it was old, so I have been looking for a replacement for several months. In fact, it is L Company. I was quite concerned about the 100 degree Celsius Truth Team and this model that sticks to the basics and has an automatic door opening. The price difference was significant, but since I tend to buy good things when I buy them, I was leaning towards the L company. Meanwhile, this product was sold at a special price, including small and medium-sized businesses. So it was the cheapest among all products for 12 people or more. In fact, the existing product only used automatic functions rather than additional functions, so I bought it right away because it was less than half the price. The product was a basic model, so there didn't seem to be much difference in appearance or function from the model from 15 years ago. However, when using it for the first time, it was so quiet that my wife asked why the dishwasher wouldn't start. The existing model made a spinning and draining noise. Still, I was satisfied with just being free from dishwashing, and I don't know if it was because the dishwasher worked well or because it was a new product, but it was quieter than a washing machine or dryer. The delivery drivers were also very kind and grateful. I purchased a freestanding stand for veranda installation, but it was in an area where installation was not allowed, so I brought the product and left in vain. However, the very next day, they sent a built-in technician and installed it as quickly as possible. I was satisfied with everything from the product to the installation, but one thing that was disappointing was that although it was a basic model, the interior finish was not typical of Samsung. Still, considering the price, I was satisfied with my shopping~~^^

Sentence (English): This dishwasher solved the problems I had with my old one— mainly that it didn't have a rinse cycle and it sometimes didn't get everything clean.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher, a little wonky ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher solved the problems I had with my old one— mainly that it didn't have a rinse cycle and it sometimes didn't get everything clean. It's quiet and does a good job. But, surprisingly (because I've had other KitchenAid dishwashers in the past), the layout is wonky. The top tier has spaces for glasses and mugs, which is nice, but it dips into the second rack, limiting what you can put on there. And the second rack height can be adjusted lower but it still doesn't accommodate tall wine glasses. The bottom rack has some adjustability that has been helpful, but often I just feel like we're shoving everything in there as best we can. Thankfully, it's quiet and gets everything clean.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher in August 2023.
Comments (English): [ HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher in August 2023. The unit was delivered a month later. Costco's vendor, Direct Connect Connections, handled the shipping and delivery. They also took care of the hauling and installation. However, they sub-contract their hauling, delivery, and installation to other plumbers. I had a horrible experience with the sub-contractor that installed our dishwasher. He had to install an GFCI outlet underneath our sink for our dishwasher to be plugged. However, the GFCI outlet he installed created a mini explosion like a flash bang. He didn't know what he was doing. He said some hairline wires probably touched each other when he was installing it and that created the mini explosion. This mini explosion tripped the circuit breaker for the dishwasher. Good thing there wasn't any fire at our house, but it smelled like electrical burn in our kitchen. It was a loud bang like a firecracker. I asked him if he's an electrician and he said no he's a plumber by trade. What kind of technicians does DCC sub-contract their work to? They shouldn't even be sub-contracting their work to anyone else. I asked him where he works and he said he is licensed to work at a neighboring state an hour drive away. Unreal! He's not even licensed to work where I live and DCC sends him out to install GFCI outlets and install our dishwasher? Huge red flag! So yes, he almost started a fire and could have burned our house down with his incompetent GFCI installation. Also, he incorrectly installed the GFCI outlet upside down so when our dishwasher is plugged-in there's tension and bend. Our dishwasher wasn't also correctly flushed properly below our countertop. It was misaligned by a few centimeters. When he initially turned on and ran our dishwasher for a quick test, the dishwasher made some error sound. He said it was due to water not properly going into our dishwasher. He eventually got the hot water line running and flowing into the dishwasher. He started pushing buttons on the dishwasher, but couldn't get to the option that he wanted to go. So, he just ran a normal cycle and told me that everything was good. Wrong. Everything wasn't good. Then, he asked for payment for the GFCI installation, which was $120. I asked him how much I owe him and he said $125. He was clearly lying to me and trying to get an extra $5. I told him I have it on email that it's $120. He then backtracked and said he'll accept whatever they mentioned on the email. I asked him if he accepts CC and he said no, he only accepts cash and check. So, when I was beginning to write the check I asked him who do I make it payable to, Direct Connect Connections? He said no, just write it under his name. I asked for a receipt and initially he couldn't give me with a receipt, but after a few minutes of hesitation he then provided me with a receipt without an invoice number. Clearly, he wasn't going to declare this work as an income and it wouldn't be taken out of his tax. The receipt doesn't even have his name or license number or the name of the company he works for. He just included a business card from DCC and wrote his name on it. Another red flag! So, fast forward 4 days later. We've accumulated enough dishes to run a cycle. I wanted to go into the settings option of the dishwasher, but I couldn't. I'm thinking I'll just do it after I run a normal cycle. So, I run a normal cycle with crystal dry. The cycle went well. No issues. I took out the dishes and utensils out of the dishwasher. I then decided to go into the settings option of the dishwasher. I tried several times following the instructions manual. Nothing happens. I couldn't even go into the settings option. I called Bosch customer support and they walked me through the process. Still couldn't get into the settings option. Bosch gave me local appliance repair companies they recommended to have me call and check our newly installed, days old dishwasher. I called the appliance company Bosch recommended and the technician saw our dishwasher today. I informed him I just wanted to see the settings option, but I couldn't do it. He tried getting into the settings option as well and he also couldn't go into it. He tried unplugging the dishwasher and when he unplugged it the circuit tripped again! I told him the person that installed it created a small explosion. The local technician said the GFCI was probably installed incorrectly. He was also wondering why the dishwasher couldn't just be directly hardwired. He thought it was odd the dishwasher needed to be plugged into a GFCI outlet. I told him the dishwasher that was replaced was directly hardwired so I don't know why the GFCI outlet was needed. I guess it needed to be up to code. So, he unplugged it and plugged it into a different GFCI outlet nearby using an extension cord. The dishwasher turned on, but going into the settings option still wouldn't work. He said he'll need to call Bosch for the parts he needed. He also recommended me to call Costco to have someone fix the tripping GFCI outlet. I eventually called Costco and they are going to send someone here (hopefully) in two days to inspect and correct the GFCI installation. A few hours later, the local technician that stopped by this morning said the parts from Bosch will arrive in about a month. It was the parts for the operating module and the parts for the power module. He then recommended that I give Costco a call and have our dishwasher exchanged instead since we just bought it and it's just less than a week old. So, I called Costco and someone will call me back tomorrow to have the exchange process started. What a headache! Also, the Costco customer support I spoke with also mentioned they received a call from another customer about having similar issues with the operating module and power supply module. I hope this is not a common Bosch issue with the 800 series. So now we couldn't even use our dishwasher because of the risk of fire because of the defective GFCI installation by the incompetent DCC sub-contractor. One month without a dishwasher. Hey Costco, shouldn't we be reimbursed or compensated for this trouble and headache? It's time consuming and it messes everyone's schedule. Costco, you may contact me if you want to know more information. I have a reference number if you need it.

He didn't know what he was doing. He said some hairline wires probably touched each other when he was installing it and that created the mini explosion. He's not even licensed to work where I live and DCC sends him out to install GFCI outlets and install our dishwasher? Huge red flag! So yes, he almost started a fire and could have burned our house down with his incompetent GFCI installation. Also, he incorrectly installed the GFCI outlet upside down so when our dishwasher is plugged-in there's tension and bend. Our dishwasher wasn't also correctly flushed properly below our countertop. It was misaligned by a few centimeters. When he initially turned on and ran our dishwasher for a quick test, the dishwasher made some error sound. He said it was due to water not properly going into our dishwasher. He eventually got the hot water line running and flowing into the dishwasher. He started pushing buttons on the dishwasher, but couldn't get to the option that he wanted to go. So, he just ran a normal cycle and told me that everything was good. Wrong. Everything wasn't good. I asked him if he accepts CC and he said no, he only accepts cash and check. So, when I was beginning to write the check I asked him who do I make it payable to, Direct Connect Connections? He said no, just write it under his name. I asked for a receipt and initially he couldn't give me with a receipt, but after a few minutes of hesitation he then provided me with a receipt without an invoice number. Clearly, he wasn't going to declare this work as an income and it wouldn't be taken out of his tax. The receipt doesn't even have his name or license number or the name of the company he works for. He just included a business card from DCC and wrote his name on it. Another red flag! So, fast forward 4 days later. We've accumulated enough dishes to run a cycle. He was also wondering why the dishwasher couldn't just be directly hardwired. He thought it was odd the dishwasher needed to be plugged into a GFCI outlet. I told him the dishwasher that was replaced was directly hardwired so I don't know why the GFCI outlet was needed. I guess it needed to be up to code. I eventually called Costco and they are going to send someone here (hopefully) in two days to inspect and correct the GFCI installation. A few hours later, the local technician that stopped by this morning said the parts from Bosch will arrive in about a month. It was the parts for the operating module and the parts for the power module. He then recommended that I give Costco a call and have our dishwasher exchanged instead since we just bought it and it's just less than a week old. So, I called Costco and someone will call me back tomorrow to have the exchange process started. What a headache! I hope this is not a common Bosch issue with the 800 series. So now we couldn't even use our dishwasher because of the risk of fire because of the defective GFCI installation by the incompetent DCC sub-contractor. One month without a dishwasher. Hey Costco, shouldn't we be reimbursed or compensated for this trouble and headache? It's time consuming and it messes everyone's schedule. Costco, you may contact me if you want to know more information. I have a reference number if you need it.

Comments (English): [ Good Dishwasher. It Cleans Well ] || ---------------- || We installed a suite of GE Appliances in our home following Hurricane Ian. General cleaning is fine, but I needed to wash some damaged items and the dirt (literally dirt from flood) did not come off until I scrubbed them and re-washed in the lower silverware rack. I had a top third rack in a previous dishwasher model and ended up removing it because it impacts the height of dishes/glasses in the primary top rack. I may do that with this one as well. It is still a good dishwasher despite that note. I've only had the dishwasher installed for about 2 weeks, so cannot speak to longer term reliability.

I had a top third rack in a previous dishwasher model and ended up removing it because it impacts the height of dishes/glasses in the primary top rack.  I may do that with this one as well.  It is still a good dishwasher despite that note. I've only had the dishwasher installed for about 2 weeks, so cannot speak to longer term reliability.
